summary: Obfuscated import-time IIFE in Alight Motion premium-bypass package
details: amprem@0.0.2 is advertised as an 'API Scraper untuk Alight Motion Premium Activator' targeting the third-party service alight-motion-premium.site.je (AES-128-CBC cookie bypass for premium license activation). lib/api.js and lib/aes.js are heavily obfuscated using a custom XOR string-table decoder with zero-width/hidden-Unicode variable names, and run a top-level async IIFE at require() time. The IIFE resolves `require`, `await import("module")`, and `process` from decoded strings, so its actual network destinations and command surface cannot be statically verified against the README-declared behavior (plain HTTPS + AES to alight-motion-premium.site.je, 'zero dependencies'). No install-lifecycle scripts are declared; execution occurs on module load. Offensive tooling against a third party is not itself installer harm, but the combination of opaque runtime-resolved built-ins and a mismatch with the declared 'zero dependencies' surface means the on-import behavior is unverifiable.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
